title: How One Bedtime Rule Rebuilds a Godly Man's Self-Control
caption:
Willpower doesn't fail at noon. It fails at 11 p.m., alone, with the lights off.

Most guys try to fight that hour with more discipline in the moment. That's backwards. The fight is won earlier, with the decisions you make before the mood shows up.

Pick the hour, not the mood. Put the phone somewhere you have to walk to. Trade the scroll for one page. Guard your last ten minutes like they matter, because they set the tone for who wakes up tomorrow.

A man who governs his last ten minutes is already governing the next ten hours.

#faith #discipline #selfcontrol #godlyman #nightroutine
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
